description:
Adds the Platform Activity Monitoring feature to monitor rate limiting, job load, and historical activity data on the tenant.

        Use it on a tenant project that you initialized with the **Initialize project** action of MIT.

        Please refer to the [documentation](https://doc.memority.eu/setup-guide/latest/platform-activity-monitoring-plugin) before use.
